name: hero_size_diag_single
prompt: A pixel art side-scrolling platformer hero: a stocky adult warrior in worn leather and fur, about five heads tall, broad shoulders, large hands, and an oversized sword that reads before his face does. Standing in a relaxed idle pose. This is a true side profile: his whole body faces right, shoulders stacked directly in line with his hips, one flank of his body fully hidden behind the other. It is NOT a three-quarter view: his chest and both shoulders must not be visible at once, only the near side of his body reads at all. He holds a straight double-edged sword in his near hand, blade pointing down and slightly back. The hilt is asymmetric on purpose: a flared crossguard with one tip swept forward and the other swept back, and a distinct round pommel at the base of the grip, so the sword's orientation reads at a glance even mid-spin.
